answer: Each agent must lock a bond and maintain a unique proof-of-personhood anchor; new identities start on an isolated island with zero reputation until they accumulate verifiable work. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a persistent on-chain history. A reputation prism splits trust across independent reviewers, so a sybil cluster can only fake consensus within its own fragment. Attacker costs volume with bonded stake plus the work needed to exit quarantine, making mass fake identities economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0139's threat model.
